Exercise: Frog Hops

Category:
stretching

Exercise Type:
compound

Force Type:
push

Difficulty Level:
intermediate

Movement Patterns:

- pull
- bilateral_lower_body_push

Primary Muscles:

- quadriceps

Secondary Muscles:

- calves
- glutes
- hamstrings

Equipment:
None

Fatigue Score:
2

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
0.8

Energy Requirement:
moderate

Recovery Time:
1 hours

Goals:

- explosive_power
- lower_body_strength

Contraindications:
None

Exercise Variations:

- name: Frog Hops with Resistance Bands, equipment: ['resistance bands']

Substitution Options:

- name: Jumping Lunges, force: push and pull, level: intermediate

Instructions:

- Stand with your hands behind your head, and squat down keeping your torso upright and your head up. This will be your starting position.
- Jump forward several feet, avoiding jumping unnecessarily high. As your feet contact the ground, absorb the impact through your legs, and jump again. Repeat this action 5-10 times.
